rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the opening remarks of the press conference titled 安倍内閣総理大臣就任記者会見 and dated 26 December 2012, the Prime Minister said that he had that day received appointment as the 96th Prime Minister (本日、第96代内閣総理大臣を拝命いたしました) and had formed an LDP-Komeito coalition government.
